verdict.rationale: Statsig's own docs show you can create a Feature Gate and toggle product behavior in real time without deploying code, including an emergency disable switch for production users. A first-feature tutorial creates a gate and checks it live via the JavaScript SDK. Feature flags are included free, and the quickstart claims only a few lines of code. However, the 'within minutes of signing up' time-to-value is not evidenced by any measured onboarding time or hands-on report, and one community comment mentions spending 'quite some time' on an integration. missing for 10: evidence of signup-to-live-toggle time (minutes), independent hands-on corroboration of the onboarding flow.

support.subject: As a developer, I can create a feature flag and toggle it live in production within minutes of signing up

citations.quote: Feature Gates, commonly known as feature flags, allow you to toggle the behavior of your product in real time without deploying new code.
Have an emergency disable switch that lets you immediately turn off a particular code branch for users in production
This tutorial creates a feature gate, targets mobile platforms and internal testers, then checks it live with the JavaScript SDK in your browser console.
You get feature flags and 2 million metered events for free.
Get data flowing into Statsig with only a few lines of code.
